test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following technologies was used to fabricate the Vikram 3201 microprocessor launched in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**180nm CMOS technology**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Vikram 3201 microprocessor, launched in 2025, was fabricated using **180nm CMOS technology**, which is widely regarded as a robust and cost-effective process for microprocessor manufacturing.
 
• **180nm CMOS technology** provides a balanced trade-off between performance, power efficiency, and manufacturing costs, making it ideal for embedded systems and mid-range applications.
 
• This technology has been extensively used in the development of processors, microcontrollers, and SoCs (System on Chips) for consumer electronics and industrial applications.
 
• The Vikram 3201 is expected to play a critical role in advancing India's semiconductor capabilities and reducing dependency on imports.
 
• The development of processors like Vikram 3201 aligns with India’s vision for self-reliance under the "Make in India" initiative, emphasizing indigenous semiconductor manufacturing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CMOS Technology:** Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) technology is a widely used semiconductor fabrication process known for its low power consumption and high density of integration.
 
• **Semiconductor Nodes:** Semiconductor nodes like 180nm, 90nm, and 7nm define the size of transistors in the chip. Smaller nodes generally offer better performance and efficiency but require advanced manufacturing processes.
 
• **Fabrication Process:** The fabrication process involves designing, layering, and etching silicon wafers to create integrated circuits. 180nm technology represents a mature and reliable node for cost-sensitive applications.
 
• **Indian Semiconductor Mission:** India’s semiconductor mission aims to build a vibrant semiconductor ecosystem and promote R&D, design, and manufacturing within the country.
 
• **Embedded Systems:** Processors like Vikram 3201 are widely used in embedded systems for applications such as IoT devices, automotive control systems, and industrial automation.
